The body of a [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''ambassador''' to the [[Imperial Court/Legends|Imperial Court]] was found in a shipping container aboard the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] of the musician and actress [[Javul Charn]]. Charn later learned that the ambassador had been wanted by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] and suspected that the criminal organization [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] was responsible for his [[Death/Legends|death]].
